$comment: The single active write lease. GENERATED — do not hand-edit; use `npm run agent:lease-*`.
This file always exists. `status` other than "active" means no lease is held, which is the
normal state and leaves editing unrestricted. It is kept rather than deleted because the
Program Status dashboard registers it as a source and asserts every source is readable.
Only one lease may be active at a time — AWKIT develops directly on main, so a second
concurrent writer has nothing to isolate it. Scope grows through `agent:lease-amend`, which
re-runs routing and hands the work to the owning specialist rather than widening this grant.
